text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about with
Yaeno
Muteki...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her eyes seem drawn to a claw machine
filled with
Umamusume plushies called
cuties.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It's not a question of desire. I simply
cannot have
one.
choice_data_list: もしかして、欲しいのか？

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If I were to get one... If I were to cradle
it in my
arms...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
And see those pleading eyes... I would
need to
protect it!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Get plushies for the purpose of
protecting them?
That is one way to
look at it...
choice_data_list: なら、取って護ってあげよう

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Very well. I pray for your success!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
